headline: Oslo meeting today (Witkoff, Kushner virtual, Stubb attends, press conference)
dek: Zelenskiy: US decisions 'hard to explain' — no advance warning of Russian attacks on three occasions in the past week; Pentagon delaying delivery of paid-for missiles (PURL programme), one package awaiting Defence Secretary Hegseth's signature; Starshield limitations for drone ops unexplained.…
sources: President Volodymyr Zelenskiy (Telegram video to US congressional delegation); Norwegian PM Jonas Gahr Stoere (official); Reuters
fault_line: Is Washington deliberately freezing out Kyiv — or trading leverage for a seat at the Putin-Xi table? Zelenskiy says 'some political decision has been made'; Trump says 'somebody else should negotiate.'

sections.what_happened: Zelenskiy: US decisions 'hard to explain' — no advance warning of Russian attacks on three occasions in the past week; Pentagon delaying delivery of paid-for missiles (PURL programme), one package awaiting Defence Secretary Hegseth's signature; Starshield limitations for drone ops unexplained. Offers: Ukraine willing to halt strikes on Russian oil refineries for 30 days if Washington supplies Patriot interceptors. Today: Zelenskiy flies to Oslo to meet Witkoff; Kushner joins virtually; Finland's President Stubb attends; press conference with Stoere later Tuesday. Norwegian goal: 'steer the diplomatic efforts onto a more constructive path.'
sections.what_verified: Reuters via TBS News and Northland News Radio/Devdiscourse; News18; JPost/Reuters on Kushner+Witkoff Norway trip; Stoere/Stubb official statements.
sections.what_disputed: Zelenskiy's claims about US intent ('political decision to slow down support') are his interpretation; Trump said Oct 19 Russia 'has been fine' and sanctions withheld not to disrupt talks (Izvestia); Europe buying weapons on Kyiv's behalf continues. No US-side comment on the missed-warning allegation in-window.
sections.why_matters: The rupture in real time: three missed warnings, a signature that hasn't come, and a 30-day refinery-strike offer on the table in Oslo today. TOTW does the receipts — Zelenskiy's three specific claims vs the Trump administration's 'Russia has been fine' line — and the split, not the bloc.
sections.context: Background: UPDATE to Ukraine talks thread — Zelenskiy: US decisions 'hard to explain'; offers 30-day halt on refinery strikes if Patriots supplied; Oslo meeting today (Witkoff, Kushner virtual, Stubb attends, press conference)

totw_analysis: Our read: The rupture in real time: three missed warnings, a signature that hasn't come, and a 30-day refinery-strike offer on the table in Oslo today. TOTW does the receipts — Zelenskiy's three specific claims vs the Trump administration's 'Russia has been fine' line — and the split, not the bloc. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is Washington deliberately freezing out Kyiv — or trading leverage for a seat at the Putin-Xi table? Zelenskiy says 'some political decision has been made'; Trump says 'somebody else should negotiate.'
